integrity.computational_scope: Exactly 729 radius-choice matrices on six vertices; no extrapolation
integrity.proof_basis: Exhaustive exact integer radius-selection certificate plus analytic exceptional-block and equality proofs

scientific_limitations: Only the fixed six-vertex octahedron, unit graph edges, uniform counting measure, centered balls, strong real ell2 norm.
No general exact result for larger cocktail-party graphs, other p, vertex masses, or uncentered balls.
No independent scientific audit; unindexed equivalent claims remain possible.
title: Sharp \(\ell^2\) maximal norm and antipodal extremizers on the octahedral graph
